text_en: Then I saw in the right hand of the one seated on the throne a scroll written on the inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals;
text_cn: 我看见在那坐于宝座者的右手上，有一书卷，内外都写着字，用七个印密封着。

text_en: and I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals? ”
text_cn: 我又看见一位强有力的天使大声宣布说：“谁当得起展开这书卷，开启它的印呢？”

text_en: And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it.
text_cn: 但是，不论在天上、地上、或地下，没有一个能展开那书卷的，没有能阅读它的。

text_en: And I began to weep bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.
text_cn: 我就大哭起来，因为没有找着一位当得起展开那书卷，和阅读它的。

text_en: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep. See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals. ”
text_cn: 长老中有一位对我说：“不要哭！看，那出于犹大支派中的狮子，达味的苗裔已得了胜利，他能展开那书卷和那七个印。”

text_en: Then I saw between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders a Lamb standing as if it had been slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
text_cn: 我就看见在宝座和四个活物中间，并在长老们中间，站着一只羔羊，好像被宰杀过的，他有七个角和七只眼：那眼睛就是被派往全地的天主的七神。

text_en: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who was seated on the throne.
text_cn: 他于是前来，从坐在宝座上的那位右手中接了那书卷。

text_en: When he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each holding a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
text_cn: 当他接那书卷的时候，那四个活物和那二十四位长老，都俯伏在羔羊前，各拿着弦琴和盛满了香料的金盂──这香料即是众圣徒的祈祷，

text_en: They sing a new song: “You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, for you were slaughtered and by your blood you ransomed for God saints from every tribe and language and people and nation;
text_cn: 并唱新歌说：“惟有你当得起接受那书卷和开启它的印，因为你曾被宰杀，曾用你的血，从各支派、各异语、各民族、各邦国中，把人赎来归于天主，

text_en: you have made them to be a kingdom and priests serving our God, and they will reign on earth. ”
text_cn: 并使他们成为国度和司祭，事奉我们的天主；他们必要为王，统治世界。”

text_en: Then I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels surrounding the throne and the living creatures and the elders; they numbered myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
text_cn: 我又看见，且听见在宝座、活物和长老的四周，有许多天使的声音，他们的数目千千万万，

text_en: singing with full voice, “Worthy is the Lamb that was slaughtered to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing! ”
text_cn: 大声喊说：“被宰杀的羔羊堪享权能、富裕、智慧、勇毅、尊威、光荣、和赞颂！”

text_en: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, singing, “To the one seated on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever! ”
text_cn: 此后我又听见一切受造物，即天上、地上、地下和海中的万物都说：“愿赞颂、尊威、光荣和权力，归于坐在宝座上的那位和羔羊，至于无穷之世！”

text_en: And the four living creatures said, “Amen! ” And the elders fell down and worshiped.
text_cn: 那四个活物就答说：“阿们。”长老们遂俯伏朝拜。
